regularization: L2 logistic regression over frozen DINOv2 embedding
intended_use: Technical quality triage for standard and portable colour fundus photographs
excluded_use: Ultrawide-field imaging and autonomous clinical decision making
predecessor: EyeQC-v6-CFP-2026 (hand-crafted 10-axis features); superseded because it rejected 37.9% of genuinely good photographs pooled across 5 external cohorts, see diagnostics/.
threshold_calibration: Pooled across all 5 external validation cohorts (EyeQ-test, DRIMDB, FQS, MSHF-CFP, DeepDRiD), not EyeQ-train alone — see recalibrate_thresholds.py. The EyeQ-train-only thresholds are kept under *_eyeq_train_only for reference; they under-shot the 90% bad-sensitivity target on FQS (68.9%) and DeepDRiD (54.5%) once deployed outside the development distribution.
